steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the laboratory environment and materials for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Pre-cool centrifuge to 4 ℃.
Pre-heat nitrogen sample concentrator water bath and RapidVap to 35 ℃.
Ensure sufficient nitrogen gas is available, preferably using a two-stage regulator for consistent pressure.
Wipe needles and luers with KimWipes soaked in IPA to remove residue.
Label one 16x125 mm glass borosilicate culture tube for each sample and 3 extra tubes for internal standards.
Set nitrogen evaporator luer valves to the open position (1.5 turns counterclockwise from closed/12 o'clock position; red dot at 6 o'clock).

steps.title: Prepare Plant Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh and prepare the plant material for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Pre-weigh 20 mg (± 1 mg) of freeze-dried plant powder into a 15 mL snap-cap tube.
Embed all sample tubes and glass collection tubes in ice to keep them cool.

steps.title: Add Internal Standards and Solvent
steps.instruction: Add internal standards and extraction solvent to the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL of 1:1 20 µM naringin:20 µM naringenin to each sample as an internal standard.
Add 200 μL of 1:1 naringin:naringenin to the 3 internal standard-only glass collection tubes; dry immediately and store at -80 ℃.
Add 4 mL of 98:2 methanol:formic acid to each sample tube.

steps.title: Extract Phenolics
steps.instruction: Perform the extraction process through mixing and sonication.

substeps.instruction: Cap samples and vortex for ~30 seconds until mixed.
If the pellet remains stuck, alternate between vortexing and vigorous handshaking until no pellet remains.
Place samples in a sonicator water bath (add ice to keep samples cool).
Sonicate for 20 minutes for the first round; sonicate for 10 minutes for subsequent rounds.
Centrifuge at 3700 rpm (~3200 x g) for 5 minutes at 4 ℃.
Decant the supernatant into the respective glass collection tubes.
Repeat the sonication, centrifugation, and decanting steps two more times (total of 3 extractions), moving sample locations between rounds to avoid 'hot spots'.
Verify that each glass collection tube contains ~12 mL of supernatant.

steps.title: Concentrate Samples via Nitrogen Evaporation
steps.instruction: Evaporate the solvent using a nitrogen evaporator.

substeps.instruction: Load glass collection tubes (including internal standard tubes) into the nitrogen evaporator.
Lower each luer into the tube, positioned above the supernatant (typically 1-2 inches away).
Slowly open the nitrogen gas regulator (starting from the lowest flow position) until dimples form on the surface without splashing.
Lower the sample rack into the 35 ℃ warm bath if faster evaporation is desired and tighten the locking knob.
Dry samples for approximately 3 hours, checking progress every ~30 min; increase flow rate as liquid level drops to avoid splashing.
Once the liquid level is very low (a few millimeters of residual water and formic acid), turn off nitrogen flow and unload samples.

steps.title: Final Drying with RapidVap
steps.instruction: Completely remove residual moisture using the RapidVap system.

substeps.instruction: Load samples and internal standards into RapidVap.
Dry with a speed setting of 35 and a starting pressure of 200 mbar.
Stair-step the pressure down in 20 mbar steps every ~10 minutes (or sooner if the target pressure is reached easily; or longer if resistance is encountered).
Remove remaining moisture by setting the pressure to 10 mbar for 15 minutes.
Manually inspect the bottom of each vial to ensure it is dry; if moisture remains, dry for an additional 10 minutes at 10 mbar.
Cap tubes and store at -80 ℃.

steps.title: Redissolve and Dilute Samples
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the dried samples and perform a 5-fold dilution.

substeps.instruction: Allow samples to warm slightly to ~4 ℃ before opening to prevent tube cracking and condensation.
Add 5 mL of LC-MS grade 1:1 methanol:water + 0.1% formic acid to each sample tube.
Sonicate for ~10 seconds while rapidly swirling by hand to remove dried sample from walls.
Vortex for ~5 seconds, ensuring liquid reaches the upper parts of the tube.
Label an 8 mL glass vial for each sample and add 200 μL of 20 μM taxifolin.
Add 3800 μL of LC-MS grade 1:1 methanol:water + 0.1% formic acid to the 8 mL vial.
Briefly mix the redissolved sample and pipette 1 mL of it into the 8 mL vial (resulting in a total volume of 5 mL).

steps.title: Filter and Prepare for LC-MS/MS
steps.instruction: Filter the diluted samples into LC vials for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Using a 3 mL syringe, aspirate ~2.5 mL of the diluted sample along with a small air bubble.
Remove the needle and attach a 13 mm 0.20 μm PTFE filter.
Filter the sample into a labeled 2 mL glass LC vial, using the air bubble to push out trapped liquid if needed.
Cap the vials and run on LC-MS/MS. If not run immediately, store at -20 ℃ (or -80 ℃ for long-term storage).
